releases.notes:
Ported Cooperative End Access to Minecraft 26.3 on Fabric and NeoForge! 🥳

No changes were made to the Paper version. Paper server operators should continue using CEA for Paper [v0.2.0](https://github.com/ganyuke/CooperativeEndAccess/releases/tag/v0.2.0) as usual on Minecraft 26.3.

## What changed?

When you pull out an eye with a full inventory, it should now throw the eye instead of dropping it at your feet. I don't think you can even do that in normal gameplay though because you need an empty hand to even pull the eye. If you manage to do that, good for you, I suppose. ¯\\(ツ)/¯

If anything other than that changed or stopped working since the previous release [v0.2.0](https://github.com/ganyuke/CooperativeEndAccess/releases/tag/v0.2.0), please file a bug report in the GitHub issue tracker.

## What does this target?

**Fabric and NeoForge for 26.3**

Fabric and NeoForge need [adventure-platform-mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/adventure-platform-mod) 7.2.0. Fabric also needs Fabric API for 26.3.

## Known issues

- The NeoForge version's dependency `adventure-platform-mod` version `7.2.0` is a little broken on NeoForge right now. Fabric is okay, but NeoForge will crash. The NeoForge version works though with a patched version. You will have to wait until the crash is patched out to use NeoForge.
- Same as [previous release](https://github.com/ganyuke/CooperativeEndAccess/releases/tag/v0.2.0).

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ganyuke/CooperativeEndAccess/compare/v0.2.0...v0.2.2

## What changed?

No gameplay changes were intended to be made in this release. If anything changed or stopped working since the latest Paper-only release [v0.1.2](https://github.com/ganyuke/CooperativeEndAccess/releases/tag/v0.1.2), please file a bug report in the GitHub issue tracker.

## What does this target?

- **Fabric and NeoForge for 26.1.X**: support added.

Fabric and NeoForge need [adventure-platform-mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/adventure-platform-mod) 6.9.0. Fabric also needs Fabric API for 26.1.X.

## Known issues

Same as [previous release](https://github.com/ganyuke/CooperativeEndAccess/releases/tag/v0.2.0).

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ganyuke/CooperativeEndAccess/compare/v0.2.0...v0.2.1

releases.notes:
First release of Cooperative End Access with support for Fabric and NeoForge in addition to Paper! 🥳

Huge refactor of the Paper codebase, moving almost all of the original logic into a platform-agnostic pure(-ish) Java core module. Had to do a little workaround for Paper since [MultiLoader-Template](https://github.com/jaredlll08/MultiLoader-Template/tree/178d1abb85e7d4ef7903bdd8fe9f4f9e0748c80c) only supports Fabric and NeoForge out of the box.

## What changed?

No gameplay changes were intended to be made in this release. If anything changed or stopped working since the previous release [v0.1.2](https://github.com/ganyuke/CooperativeEndAccess/releases/tag/v0.1.2), please file a bug report in  GitHub issue tracker.

## What does this target?

- **Paper for 1.21 to 26.2**: API target for Paper remains 1.21, but the plugin still seems to work fine with alpha versions of Paper 26.2. No changes were needed.
- **Fabric and NeoForge for 26.2**: Going back in time seems like a pain for modding platforms, so for now I only want to support moving forward.

Fabric and NeoForge need [adventure-platform-mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/adventure-platform-mod) 7.0.0 since I don't want to bundle a 900 kB dependency. Fabric also needs Fabric API for 26.2.

## Known issues

- Using `/kill` on Fabric and NeoForge does not trigger the plugin's Ender Dragon death logic. This means that End Portals will not be permanently stabilized unless you kill the dragon yourself. Don't be the first Order of the Stone, folks.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ganyuke/CooperativeEndAccess/compare/v0.1.2...v0.2.0

Fixed some bugs:

- Don't give back an Eye of Ender on removal in Creative mode.
- Don't swallow the Eye of Ender on successful removal with a full inventory (shouldn't happen I think since you need an open hand?). But just to be safe.
- Open all collapsed but otherwise complete portals when the dragon dies.
- Breaking an End Frame now removes its owner from tracking.
- Placing an Eye of Ender into an End Frame in an invalid End Portal structure now does not throw an error in the server logs.

Might've introduced new ones, let's see what happens.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ganyuke/CooperativeEndAccess/compare/v0.1.1...v0.1.2

Please find the `.jar` for Minecraft servers running **Paper 1.21** to **1.21.11** and **26.1-26.1.2** attached below.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ganyuke/CooperativeEndAccess/compare/v0.1.0...v0.1.1
